text.title: Growth Referral Programs Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from the NPS gate to a validated referral-programme spec: measure NPS on active users, name the trigger event and its reach, define the qualifying event and the reward release, size the double-sided incentive against paid CAC and margin, build the fraud guard and the idempotency tuple, wire per-user codes and server-side attribution, compute K on 500 or more invites with cycle time and the 1/(1-K) multiplier, then write the lifecycle sequence, landing page and terms and validate.

step.name: measure-the-nps-gate
step.input: NPS or willingness-to-recommend survey results on active users from the last 90 days, with sample size and date.
step.action: Record `nps_gate` in `templates/growth-referral-programs.spec.md.j2`: `metric`, `score`, `sample_size`, `population` active_users, `measured_on`, `age_days`. If no measurement exists, run the survey before anything else.
step.decision-gate: NPS below 30, a measurement older than 90 days, or "our users love us" without a sample: stop; the programme does not launch (r-nps-gate-30-before-launch).

step.name: name-the-trigger-event
step.input: The product's instrumented activation and outcome events, with the share of users reaching each.
step.action: Pick the first event where the user has received value (first successful outcome, activation milestone, positive survey response) and record `trigger_event.name`, `reach_share` and `instrumented: true`. Never signup or the first screen.
step.decision-gate: No instrumented value event exists: instrument one first; a prompt on signup is not accepted (r-trigger-event-at-value-moment).

step.name: define-the-qualifying-event
step.input: Order data (average first order, refund window) or the activation milestone definition.
step.action: Set `qualifying_event.kind` to first_paid_order with `minimum_order_value`, or activation_milestone with the event `name`. Write the condition verbatim into `templates/landing-page.md.j2` (FAQ) and every email in `templates/emails.md.j2`; set `stated_on_landing_page` and `stated_in_every_email` to true only once the copy carries it.
step.decision-gate: Reward on account creation, or a condition the landing page does not state: not accepted (r-reward-on-qualifying-event-not-signup).

step.name: size-the-double-sided-incentive
step.input: Blended paid CAC; first-order gross margin or expected LTV; the reward budget.
step.action: Set `referrer_reward` and `referee_reward` (kind, amount, currency), `reward_cost_per_qualified_referee` as their sum, `blended_paid_cac`, `margin_basis`, `margin_basis_value` and `max_reward_share_of_basis`. Check cost at or below CAC and at or below share x basis.
step.decision-gate: One-sided reward, or reward per qualified referee above paid CAC or above the stated share of margin or LTV: redesign the amounts before going on (r-double-sided-incentive-within-unit-economics).

step.name: build-the-fraud-guard
step.input: Account, payment and device data available at referee sign-up and checkout; the refund and chargeback windows.
step.action: Record `fraud_guard`: new-account-only, one referral per email and per payment instrument, `self_referral_signals` payment_instrument, device_fingerprint, ip, normalised_email with `email_normalisation` plus_addressing and dot_variants, `reward_hold_days` covering the refund or chargeback window, and `idempotency_key` referrer_id, referee_id, qualifying_event for reward fulfilment.
step.decision-gate: Any signal missing, no hold, or a fulfilment retry without the tuple: the programme does not launch (r-fraud-guard-self-referral-and-idempotent-rewards).

step.name: wire-server-side-attribution
step.input: The share surfaces, landing page and email infrastructure; the account-creation code path.
step.action: Issue a unique per-user code or link; confirm the landing page and emails accept the referral parameter; record `capture_methods` (url_parameter, first_party_cookie, code_at_signup) and `persisted_server_side_at: referee_account_creation`; set `utm_only: false`.
step.decision-gate: The landing or email infrastructure cannot carry the parameter: skip per 06-decision-tree.xml; utm-only attribution is forbidden (r-referral-attribution-server-side).

step.name: compute-k-on-500-invites
step.input: Invite, referee sign-up and referrer counts from the beta or the first cycles; trigger-to-qualifying timestamps; `templates/k_factor.py`.
step.action: With at least 500 invites and 50 active referrers, run `k_factor(invites_sent, signups_from_invites, active_referrers)` and record `invites`, `active_referrers`, `referee_signups`, `invites_per_referrer`, `conversion_per_invite`, `k`, `cycle_time_days` (median trigger event to qualifying event). For K below 1 set `presented_as: cac_multiplier` with `cac_multiplier` = 1 / (1 - k); net reward cost into the projection and set `netted_of_reward_cost: true`.
step.decision-gate: Fewer than 500 invites or 50 referrers: no K is reported; K below 1 described as viral growth is rewritten as the multiplier (r-k-factor-computed-on-500-plus-invites).

step.name: write-lifecycle-landing-page-and-terms-and-validate
step.input: `templates/emails.md.j2`, `templates/landing-page.md.j2`; the legal review of programme terms.
step.action: Record `lifecycle`: `announcement.send_on` = the trigger event, `reminder` after a stated interval (the template uses 14 days) to zero_referrals only with `max_sends` 1, `confirmation` on qualifying_event to referrer and referee, `promises_reward_before_qualifying_event: false`. Record `disclosure`: reward disclosed on shared content, `terms_url`, `terms_cover` qualifying_event, reward_timing, exclusions, fraud_reversal, and every `earnings_claims[]` entry verified for its period. Run `scripts/validate-growth-referral-programs.py --file` on the spec.
step.decision-gate: A reminder to users who already referred, a promise before the qualifying event, or shared content without disclosure: the sequence does not send (r-lifecycle-sequence-trigger-reminder-confirmation, r-incentive-disclosure-and-published-terms).

list.item: Spec validates via `scripts/validate-growth-referral-programs.py` with no violation, including the reward ceilings, the K arithmetic and the announcement-on-trigger check.
The landing page FAQ and every email state the qualifying condition verbatim; the terms page is published at `disclosure.terms_url`.
A named reviewer has signed off on the reward amounts and the fraud guard before the programme, the reward release or the lifecycle sequence goes live.
